description: Defines a Point class with methods for geometric operations, including creation, cloning, addition, subtraction, scaling, rounding, distance calculation, and string representation. It also exports a factory function to create Point instances from various input formats.

classes.name: Point
classes.description: Represents a 2D point with x and y coordinates, providing methods for geometric manipulations.

methods.name: Point
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Point object with x and y coordinates, optionally rounded.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current Point.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new Point that is the sum of the current Point and another.

methods.name: _add
methods.description: Internal method to add another Point to the current Point, modifying it.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Returns a new Point that is the difference between the current Point and another.

methods.name: _subtract
methods.description: Internal method to subtract another Point from the current Point, modifying it.

methods.name: divideBy
methods.description: Returns a new Point scaled down by dividing x and y by a number.

methods.name: _divideBy
methods.description: Internal method to divide the current Point's coordinates by a number, modifying it.

methods.name: multiplyBy
methods.description: Returns a new Point scaled up by multiplying x and y by a number.

methods.name: _multiplyBy
methods.description: Internal method to multiply the current Point's coordinates by a number, modifying it.

methods.name: scaleBy
methods.description: Returns a new Point scaled by another Point's x and y.

methods.name: unscaleBy
methods.description: Returns a new Point with coordinates divided by another Point's x and y.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Returns a new Point with x and y rounded to the nearest integers.

methods.name: _round
methods.description: Internal method to round the current Point's coordinates.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Returns a new Point with x and y floored (rounded down).

methods.name: _floor
methods.description: Internal method to floor the current Point's coordinates.

methods.name: ceil
methods.description: Returns a new Point with x and y ceiled (rounded up).

methods.name: _ceil
methods.description: Internal method to ceil the current Point's coordinates.

methods.name: trunc
methods.description: Returns a new Point with x and y truncated towards zero.

methods.name: _trunc
methods.description: Internal method to truncate the current Point's coordinates.

methods.name: distanceTo
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance to another Point.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another Point has the same coordinates.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if another Point's coordinates are within the absolute bounds of this Point.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Point.
